_comment: AGENT DEBUG preset: focused on subagent behavior. The `agents` channel ships with subtype_split=true AND collect={"agent_context": true} by default (#53), so each `.agents-<type>_*` file carries that agent's FULL story -- dispatch prompt, every internal tool call it ran (attributed), and its final report -- automatically when agents fire. The explicit `agents` entry below just restates those defaults so this preset is self-documenting; to watch only specific agents, use the list form: "collect": {"agent_context": ["oracle", "senior-engineer"]} (and matching "subtype_split": [...]).
